# PlanCheck

PlanCheck is a free, browser-based PostgreSQL EXPLAIN and EXPLAIN ANALYZE analyzer.

Canonical site: https://plancheck.dev/
Analyzer: https://plancheck.dev/analyze
EXPLAIN ANALYZE guide: https://plancheck.dev/guides/postgresql-explain-analyze
Privacy: https://plancheck.dev/privacy
PostgreSQL EXPLAIN reference: https://plancheck.dev/postgresql-explain
Full AI reference: https://plancheck.dev/llms-full.txt
Source: https://github.com/ashraf-mse/plan-check_v2

## Core principle

PlanCheck uses deterministic PostgreSQL rules rather than generative AI to diagnose execution plans. Findings distinguish observed evidence, interpretation, limitations, and next checks.

## Supported input

- PostgreSQL EXPLAIN text
- PostgreSQL EXPLAIN ANALYZE text
- PostgreSQL EXPLAIN JSON
- EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, FORMAT JSON)

## Diagnostic topics

- Rows Removed by Filter: https://plancheck.dev/postgresql-explain/rows-removed-by-filter
- Sequential Scan: https://plancheck.dev/postgresql-explain/sequential-scan
- Row estimate mismatch: https://plancheck.dev/postgresql-explain/row-estimate-mismatch
- Nested Loop: https://plancheck.dev/postgresql-explain/nested-loop
- Disk sort spill: https://plancheck.dev/postgresql-explain/disk-sort

## Privacy

Production analysis runs in the browser. SQL text and EXPLAIN plan contents are not uploaded to PlanCheck for analysis.
